description:
The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of frames and memory usage for several models. The x-axis is labeled “Number of Frames” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1000, with tick labels at intervals of 200. The y-axis is labeled “Memory (GB)” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 400, with tick labels at intervals of 50. 

The first line, representing VideoLLaMB, is red with circular markers and a dashed line style. It starts at approximately 3 GB at 0 frames, rises steadily to 10 GB at 200 frames, continues to around 16 GB at 800 frames, and concludes at approximately 17 GB at 1000 frames. The second line, representing VideoLLaMB-R, is orange with circular markers and a solid line style, beginning at just over 1 GB at 0 frames and rising to approximately 5 GB at 1000 frames. The line for PLLaVA is green with circular markers and a solid line style, starting at around 1 GB at 0 frames and ending at approximately 6 GB at 1000 frames. LLaVA-NeXT is represented by a blue line with circular markers and a solid line style, beginning at 2 GB at 0 frames and reaching approximately 18 GB at 1000 frames. Finally, VideoLAVA is depicted as a purple line with circular markers and a solid line style, showing a value of nearly 0 GB at 0 frames, increasing rapidly to 250 GB at 200 frames, and ending at approximately 380 GB at 1000 frames.
